note: First-party OWASP Benchmark v1.2 result for Zennoxa Shield. Shield-only: contains no competitor data.

tool.name: Zennoxa Shield
tool.engine: SAST: regex + intra-file taint + dataflow (constant-fold / key-sensitive maps)
tool.release_note: Measured on engine commit 515fff7 (2026-08-04) with the public CLI release v0.5.0, re-scored unchanged on v0.7.0 and reproduced on 2026-09-24 from the v0.7.0 release binary via bench/owasp/reproduce.sh: +0.582, precision 92.5%, recall 63.7%, FPR 5.5% over 2,740 cases. The scorer (bench/owasp/score.py) and the dataset pin are in this repository.

benchmark.score_metric: Benchmark Score = TPR - FPR (Youden's J), strict OWASP CWE-per-category match; scorer: bench/owasp/score.py

reproduce: The script downloads the tagged binary for your OS, verifies it against the release SHA256SUMS, fetches BenchmarkJava at the pinned commit, checks the ground-truth CSV checksum, runs `shield scan` over the test cases, scores with bench/owasp/score.py and compares the result with this file (tolerance 0.005).
SHIELD_BIN=/path/to/shield bench/owasp/reproduce.sh scores a binary you built yourself; OWASP_BENCH=/path/to/BenchmarkJava reuses an existing checkout.
reproducibility_note: Every figure here is produced on the public OWASP Benchmark v1.2 suite (2,740 labelled Java cases) with the released binary. To compare other tools, use OWASP's own published scorecards and run every tool at its default configuration; we do not measure other tools here.
